cells.value: Completed phase attempts attributed to the completion actor. Wall-clock spans include waiting and interruptions; they are not active model time. elapsedMs sums known signed spans only; unknown counts attempts missing either endpoint. Retries are separate attempts. Overlapping work orders can overlap in these totals. No checkpoint times are recovered.
